issue.title: gcal_ack session tests use fixed sleeps before card readiness and journal writes
issue.description: Both tests in tests/gcal_ack.rs assume progress after fixed wall-clock delays: session_timed_presses_answer_each_card schedules a second a after 400/800 ms, while session_write_failure_keeps_earlier_answers reads .bob/gcal after 1200 ms. Under load, the second key arrives during debounce or the first journal write has not completed. Replace elapsed-time assumptions with bounded observation of card readiness and persisted first receipt, preserving assertions about debounce and earlier-answer durability. This is test harness work, unrelated to the props planner.

task_type_fields.evidence: Reported by bob-cli-pf.2.1.2 note #2 on 2026-11-22: session_timed_presses_answer_each_card and session_write_failure_keeps_earlier_answers failed during full-suite loadavg about 198 (one of two acked; missing journal after 1200 ms), then both passed isolated on the same tree. Failure rate beyond that one suite run was not recorded. Lander source audit confirms fixed 400/800 ms and 1200 ms waits at tests/gcal_ack.rs:1560 and :1591; no fresh lander reproduction.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-pf.2.1.2 note #2 reported two failures under full-suite load and isolated passes on an unchanged tree. Landing triage found no matching task or causally responsible active epic.
